delivery: The mill will have a temporary change on Thursday for receiving deliveries. The rear loading bay will be closed until 11:40 am. Drivers with parcels of 12 kg or less can put them at the front desk before then. Heavier parcels require the driver to call the warehouse supervisor and wait in the vehicle for instructions. After 11:40 am the loading bay works as usual. The change is for Thursday only and the person expecting a parcel does not need to contact the warehouse or meet the driver outside.
meter: On Monday, meter A read 18 kWh and meter B read 21 kWh. On Tuesday, meter A read 16 kWh. Meter B gave no Tuesday reading because its display was blank. A blank should be entered as missing in the report. That blank is not proof the machine used zero electricity. The technician will revisit meter B on Friday. Until then the workshop cannot compare total electricity consumption between the two days using these figures.
tickets:
The hall says ticket holders should know what to do if the afternoon performance on 4 May is cancelled.

A card payer can ask for a refund by emailing the box office within ten working days. A cash payer must bring the original ticket to the box office in person. No deadline has been set for cash customers. Neither group gets an automatic refund.

At the moment the performance is still scheduled. The announcement lets people keep the relevant documents and should not be taken as a cancellation notice.
